# Legacy declaration migration for the narrow team execution profile

Status: documentation contract finalized in the operator-authorized documentation-only child Execute, 2026-09-30. Parent implementation and operation remain pending. Read with [plan.md](plan.md), [execution-profile-contract.md](execution-profile-contract.md) and [parent-repair-handoff.md](parent-repair-handoff.md). Profile diagnostics below use the frozen execution-profile codes and exact field pointers; they are contracts to implement, not claims that the baseline emits them.

## Evidence and scope

Baseline UAR `006eeaf1f90e0a640b0f8fd568419badac5f4320` retains the existing unbuilt provider candidate; Boss `c00d9b68695fb452d1f09bd4b154582ecaad0035`. This document changes no stored definition, private binding, receipt or application source. A1 owns publication of this guidance as `docs/agents/collaboration/team-execution-profile-migration.md` in UAR before the product release. The deployed copy must use repository-relative source references and record its implemented version and acceptance receipt.

The draft.2 AgentDefinition uses `/context`, whose closed schema defines `mode`, `artifacts`, `history` and `memoryScopes`; DeploymentBinding separately uses `/contextGrants`. These are the exact source identifiers. `context` is not a TeamDefinition field in the baseline. See [common.schema.json:91](/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/worktrees/agent-fabric-c09-uar/docs/agents/collaboration/v0.1.0-draft.2/schemas/common.schema.json:91), [AgentDefinition:79](/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/worktrees/agent-fabric-c09-uar/docs/agents/collaboration/v0.1.0-draft.2/schemas/agent-definition.schema.json:79) and [DeploymentBinding:196](/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/worktrees/agent-fabric-c09-uar/docs/agents/collaboration/v0.1.0-draft.2/schemas/deployment-binding.schema.json:196).

The ordinary semantics resolver evaluates the five semantic requirement fields but not these legacy selection fields. The team receipt narrows KB/presentation selection to none and disables ambient memory. The working selected-artifact path consumes **attempt** `contextArtifactIds`; it does not consume AgentDefinition `/context/artifacts` or binding `/contextGrants`. See [runtime_semantics.rs:17](/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/worktrees/agent-fabric-c09-uar/src/uar/compiler/collaboration/runtime_semantics.rs:17), [team policy:147](/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/worktrees/agent-fabric-c09-uar/src/uar/compiler/collaboration/team_execution/resolution.rs:147) and [selected_team_context:46](/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/worktrees/agent-fabric-c09-uar/src/uar/compiler/collaboration/team_execution/scope.rs:46). Baseline storage/schema acceptance is not execution support.

## Field-specific changes

Every diagnostic carries document kind and immutable definition identity or private binding revision, exact RFC 6901 pointer, disposition, stable reason code, safe remediation and effective receipt reference. A package-level diagnostic identifies the affected member definition; it does not blame a generic package field. Report each unsupported item, not only the first failure. Retain the original requested value in protected/portable storage according to its existing classification; do not copy private grant values into public diagnostics.

| Exact field and triggering value | Baseline behavior | Required new behavior | Planned code and operator remediation |
|---|---|---|---|
| AgentDefinition `/context/mode` = `authorized-fork` | Shape retained; team execution does not implement an authorized history fork | `required-unsupported` at this pointer; refuse executable preflight/admission | `TEAM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED_UNSUPPORTED`. Keep planning/export, or author a new immutable definition explicitly selecting the narrow profile without fork semantics, then install/rebind deliberately. Do not silently change the old value. |
| AgentDefinition `/context/mode` = `selected`, with a nonempty selection below | Mode is not a resolver for the authored resource references | Identify the unsupported resource pointer(s) below; no blanket denial of the word `selected` | No extra generic mode error is required. An empty selected request with `artifacts: []`, `history: none`, `memoryScopes: []` requests no additional resources and stays compatible. `none` also stays compatible. |
| AgentDefinition `/context/artifacts/{i}` for every nonempty authored artifact reference | Preserved; not joined to the attempt's authorized durable artifact selection | `required-unsupported` for each reference until definition-to-runtime selection is implemented | `TEAM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED_UNSUPPORTED`. For the narrow profile, explicitly revise the definition to empty this unsupported declaration and select an authorized team artifact via the existing per-admission `contextArtifactIds` control. This requires operator intent and a new immutable definition/package/binding, not an automatic rewrite. |
| AgentDefinition `/context/history` = `selected` | Preserved; no authored history-selection mapping in this team path | `required-unsupported`; refuse rather than union histories | `TEAM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED_UNSUPPORTED`. Use explicit task input or scoped selected artifacts in a deliberately revised definition, or retain the requirement and wait for the context-owner increment. |
| AgentDefinition `/context/history` = `authorized-summary` | Preserved; no grant-bound authored summary mapping in this team path | `required-unsupported`; no substitute summary inferred from ambient host history | `TEAM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED_UNSUPPORTED`. Obtain the future supported summary/grant mapping, or deliberately remove this requirement in a new definition. `/context/history` = `none` remains compatible. |
| AgentDefinition `/context/memoryScopes/{i}` for every nonempty scope | Preserved; team policy sets `memory_enabled: false` | `required-unsupported` for each scope; no ambient or shared-memory fallback | `TEAM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED_UNSUPPORTED`. Retain the requirement for the deferred context/memory increment, or explicitly author an empty-scope narrow-profile version. Ordinary host memory availability does not make this declaration supported. |
| DeploymentBinding `/contextGrants/{i}` for every nonempty reference | Required array retained; no team disclosure mapping from these entries into selected context | `required-unsupported` for each reference in executable preflight, rebind and launch; private reference remains private | `TEAM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED_UNSUPPORTED`. Keep the existing binding/history; create an explicit compatible revision only when the operator agrees no such grant is required, or wait for the grant-consuming implementation. Removing a reference does not revoke or erase its external grant. Empty array remains compatible. |
| AgentDefinition `/permittedChildren/{i}` for every immutable child reference when execution is requested | Package graph verifies immutable closure; no exact allowed-definition mapping into ordinary child execution | `required-unsupported` for the requested child-execution declaration until the mapping exists; do not advertise root-local child tools as this implementation | `TEAM_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED`. Keep the definition portable/plannable. Use the supported direct durable member profile without child execution only through an explicit new definition/binding, or await the deferred C09 extension. |
| TeamDefinition `/members/{i}/kind` = `team`, with its `/members/{i}/definition` | Planning creates a member record retaining kind/reference; executable resolution requires an AgentDefinition | Refuse durable nested-subteam execution at the member's kind/reference; do not flatten a TeamDefinition into one AgentDefinition | `TEAM_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED`. Keep the plan; choose a separately authored agent-member profile or await bounded child TeamInstance execution with ancestor budget. A cardinality slot/reference is not an executable subteam. |

These conditions apply to unsupported authored selections independently of `/context/mode`; `mode: none` cannot make a nonempty artifacts/history/memory request disappear. Schema-invalid or contradictory input still follows normal structural validation. The profile adds no speculative fallback and does not turn arbitrary legacy prose into a new field-level execution refusal.

## Required RAG and supported fields retain their current meaning

`/ragConfiguration` is an existing semantic requirement with `{required, value}`. The baseline emits `runtime.component-unavailable` at `/ragConfiguration`; `required: true` is already `required-unsupported` and blocks activation. Do not describe this as a newly introduced refusal. An optional unsupported RAG value remains preserved/excluded with its diagnostic, not executed by this profile. See [existing unsupported mapping:337](/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/worktrees/agent-fabric-c09-uar/src/uar/compiler/collaboration/runtime_semantics.rs:337) and [required disposition:370](/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/worktrees/agent-fabric-c09-uar/src/uar/compiler/collaboration/runtime_semantics.rs:370).

`/contextStrategy` is separate from `/context`: supported policies already map into the ordinary turn strategy. Preserve that mapping; do not refuse it merely because nonempty selection fields above are unsupported. `/apiHarness`, model requirements and prompt dialect keep their field-specific supported/unsupported semantics and the approved exact request-profile repair. No broad `context unavailable` error replaces their diagnostics.

Preserve every exact SkillRef and DeploymentBinding `/skillBindings`: ID, version, digest, required flag, configuration, entrypoint and required tools. Existing exact skill resolution and selected skill/MCP/tool policy remain valid. An empty skill selection means none; it does not authorize ambient inventory. A skill carrying a separately supported tool is not evidence that implicit shared KB/history/memory selection is implemented.

`/representationGrantRefs` is distinct private authority state with existing validation. This migration does not reject all nonempty representation references, issue authority, rewrite grants or conflate them with `/contextGrants`.

Legacy Markdown import currently emits empty `permittedChildren` and `{mode: none, artifacts: [], history: none, memoryScopes: []}` while retaining source descriptor/legacy sections. Those empty canonical fields remain compatible. Nonempty preserved source prose is evidence of its original authoring, not by itself an executable canonical selection or a reason to reject every imported agent. Reconcile author intent explicitly if translating it into one of the fields above; retain source/authored-field provenance. See [migration defaults:141](/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/worktrees/agent-fabric-c09-uar/src/uar/compiler/collaboration/migration.rs:141).

## Optional declarations, install/launch and rollback

Draft.2's closed `/context` and `contextGrants` shapes have no per-selection optional flag. A caller cannot add `required: false` to those arrays/values and claim compatibility. The approved next schema may explicitly express optional selections. Only a declared supported schema representation can exclude an unsupported optional request with an `optional-unsupported` field diagnostic and requested/excluded/effective receipt entry. Legacy nonempty selections remain required by default; no blanket optional downgrade.

Parent A1 implements these diagnostics at executable binding/member preflight and rechecks them at launch against current capability; team-package preflight must inspect the actual member definitions rather than admit solely from a service capability bit. Pending/runnable attempts with old bindings do not bypass unsupported semantics. Empty legacy declarations remain narrow and need no background migration. Planning/import/export preserves immutable definitions even when executable activation is refused.

Operator remediation sequence: inspect exact pointer and installed definition/package/binding revision; choose to preserve the requirement and wait, or deliberately author a new compatible immutable version; recompute canonical/exact-byte digests and lock closure; preflight against the chosen runtime profile; explicitly install/rebind with expected revision; inspect requested/effective/excluded receipt and localized Boss guidance before admitting work. Never overwrite the same immutable ID/version with a different digest, silently revise historical receipts, erase external effects, or tell the operator to delete storage. A compatible rollback is another explicit rebind and does not reverse already issued effects.

The uncomfortable limitation is deliberate: a definition that previously appeared executable while its nonempty resource selection was ignored may now refuse. That change protects the declared task contract. The implementation/release must publish these exact field dispositions; the documentation-only child is not evidence that those refusals or their UI already operate.
